name: vibe-surgeon
description: A local safety layer for AI-coded repositories: health scan, dependency blast radius, MCP tools and GitHub SARIF.

scripts.smoke: node ./bin/vibe-surgeon.mjs scan . --json > /tmp/vibe-scan.json && node ./bin/vibe-surgeon.mjs map . --json > /tmp/vibe-map.json && node ./bin/vibe-surgeon.mjs context . && node ./bin/vibe-surgeon.mjs sarif .
